title: Enable Vulkan soft-body Gallery domains
scope: Compile, bind and qualify existing shared Slang soft-body, geometry-soft-body and fluid-soft-body schedules for the Vulkan driver.
acceptance: Soft body, rigid coupling and fluid coupling scenes pass bounded lifecycle and visible-output checks on Vulkan.
Vulkan advertises only the exact soft-body and coupling capabilities supported by passing public-API contracts.

history.reason: Vulkan now compiles and binds the shared soft-body, rigid-soft-body and fluid-soft-body Slang schedules; exact advertised capabilities are backed by validated public-command and common-session Gallery contracts
